## Changes

- Default unwatched-episode blur off, preserving explicit existing profile choices.
- Preserve watched state during playback completion and bind delayed history writes to the playback profile. Improve episode progress aggregation and request urgent cloud sync for watched/unwatched changes.
- Add TorBox API-key configuration under Settings → Integrations → TorBox. Credentials are stored encrypted and included in encrypted account sync.
- Verify torrent cache availability and recent seeder observations using read-only TorBox APIs. Cached torrents receive higher scores within the same resolution tier; higher-resolution priority is preserved.
- Remove confirmed uncached torrents with zero TorBox seeders. Failed, incomplete or unverifiable checks remain unknown rather than being treated as zero. Show TorBox availability in source rows.

## Setup And Limitations

Enter your TorBox API key to enable verification. Streams need a usable infohash. Checks have a bounded 15-second lookup budget and four concurrent tracker probes; seeder observations may be reused for up to 60 seconds. TorBox responses may themselves be cached, and reported seeders do not guarantee a successful download. No torrents are created or downloaded by these checks.

## Verification

194 local JVM tests passed, including final signed-APK verification. Release lint has no errors. Instrumentation sources compiled; live TorBox, physical TV and two-device cloud testing remain pending.

Signed 32-bit armeabi-v7a APK for Android 8.0 and newer using the existing release key. Install over the previous version without uninstalling.
